text:
Rina Patel: Quick pulse on SableMetrics onboarding health  p95 creeping to ~410ms over last 48h (target 290ms) and token spend up ~19%. Renewal touch in ~6w. Looking for a low-risk, measurable win: small int8 cohort + hybrid route (compact-embed -> compact-gen) for retrieval-heavy flows. Thoughts?
Oliver Grant: Makes sense. Can we do cohort-based rollout instead of pct so we can pick non-critical customers?
Rina Patel: Yep. I prefer cohort = beta-onboarders. Also want to exclude `billing` and `auth` flows.
Sam Coleman: Recommend 3% cohort to start, route logic: if meta.doc_refs > 0 OR meta.kv_len > 1200 then run embed on compact-embed-v1 then gen on compact-gen-v2. Fallback to sable-large-fp16 if retrieval confidence < 0.7.
Tess Morales: Agree. Add a quality gate: hallucination delta <2% and anchor-avg >=96.5% on onboarding suite. Also capture p99 and token-cost delta.
Rina Patel: Ops-friendly routing snippet for their SREs (handy to paste into their control plane): ```json
{
  "cohort": "beta-onboarders",
  "exclude_tags": ["billing","auth"],
  "route": [
    {"match": {"meta.doc_refs": {">": 0}, "meta.priority": "normal"}, "steps": ["compact-embed-v1","compact-gen-v2"], "fallback": "sable-large-fp16"}
  ]
}
```
Oliver Grant: @ops-bot please run a perf-smoke comparing hybrid route vs baseline for a sample of 450 anonymized onboarding traces. Capture p50/p95/p99, token-cost per request, and anchor-accuracy on 10 prompts.
ops-bot: Queued job perf-smoke/sable-hybrid-001. Samples: 450. ETA ~30m. I'll post the summary here.
Sam Coleman: Gate command for auto-checks: `eval-suite run --customer sablemetrics --suite onboarding-anchors --min-avg 0.965 --check-hallucination 0.02`  fail -> rollback.
ops-bot: perf-smoke/sable-hybrid-001 complete  summary: hybrid p95 -17%, p99 -9%, token cost per req -14.1%. Anchor avg = 96.8% (hallucination delta +0.9%). Logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/sable-hybrid-001
Tess Morales: Those numbers look like a solid win. Proposed ramp: 48h on beta cohort -> 24h to expand to 15% of non-SLA traffic (only `normal` priority) -> 48h @50% if stable. Auto-rollback if eval <96.5% or p99 increases.
Rina Patel: I'll coordinate SRE window and customer comms. Need a short 1-slide summary for renewal: baseline, experiment, results, expected cost delta and p95 improvement.
Oliver Grant: I'll draft the slide bullets and include the perf link + before/after numbers. Drop it in 90m.
Sam Coleman: I'll prepare a rollback playbook with CLI steps to flip cohort routing, revoke model alias, and run the eval-suite health check. Also a small troubleshooting checklist (errors, latency spikes, divergence).
Tess Morales: Add request-level logging for the first 24h of the cohort so we can audit any semantic diffs quickly. Also schedule a brief ops sign-off call after the 15% expansion.
Rina Patel: Action items: Rina -> coordinate SRE window & customer note; Oliver -> renewal slide; Sam -> rollback playbook; Tess -> monitoring, logging, and ops sign-off.
Oliver Grant: Also try to capture a one-liner from SableMetrics ops after the 15% step for the renewal deck.
Rina Patel: Thanks team. I'll post the enablement doc & SRE snippet link when it's ready. :sparkles:
